reason: Review correction for google-adk-python-tutorial-2026: the printed Runner example called InMemorySessionService.create_session without awaiting it, the adk --help deploy line was cited to a file that did not contain a help capture, and the lead sentence over-claimed which instructions had been executed.

environment.scratch: private per-run TMPDIR (isolated venv, not shared /tmp)
environment.install: python3 -m venv venv; pip install --upgrade pip; pip install google-adk==2.13.0
environment.install_note: The release was pinned in this pass only, to 2.13.0, the version the first pass resolved from the unpinned command; the article's public instruction remains the unpinned 'pip install google-adk'.
environment.network: pip only; no model call, no credential, no vendor API

commands.command: ./venv/bin/adk --help   (with 'adk --version' and the Python version recorded in the file header)

findings.create_session_sync_stderr: Deprecated. Please migrate to the async method.
findings.runner_run_signature: (self, *, user_id: str, session_id: str, new_message: types.Content, state_delta: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None, run_config: Optional[RunConfig] = None) -> Generator[Event, None, None]
findings.adk_help_deploy_line: deploy       Deploys agent to hosted environments.

artifacts.description: Probe script: reproduces the un-awaited create_session failure, runs the corrected async form, reads the session back, probes create_session_sync and the Runner.run generator signature. No network, no model call.
Raw JSON stdout of that probe, including the AttributeError reproduction, the corrected session id and state read-back, and the not-covered list.
stderr of the probe: the sync shim's deprecation notice and the 'coroutine was never awaited' RuntimeWarning.
Captured 'adk --help' output from the venv (adk, version 2.13.0), with the command line, UTC timestamp and interpreter recorded in the header.
Unchanged first-pass record for the install/import/construction/tool-boundary check; still the evidence for those sections.

not_covered: No Gemini/Vertex model call: no credential in this run, so Runner.run was never iterated and no response text, latency or answer quality was observed.
No pipeline execution and no optional extra installed.
adk create, adk run and adk web were not executed; only 'adk --help' and 'adk --version' were.
